internalDomain.description: Base domain for internal service hostnames.

storageClass.description: StorageClass for data the volume must protect. Empty uses the cluster default.

localStorageClass.description: StorageClass for data the application replicates itself or can re-derive. Empty uses the cluster default.

apps.description: Which components of this layer are deployed.

enabled.description: true or false to decide explicitly; unset or null to follow the owning capability.

propertyNames.description: Generated by tools/check-values-typos.sh --write: every component name any layer declares (TM-0404).

modelGateway.description: Objects this chart renders around the vendored LiteLLM chart.

expectCA.description: Is a Tockmox CA coming to the Open WebUI pod? null follows global.certIssuer; true or false overrides it.

name.description: CNPG Cluster name. litellm.db.endpoint must be <name>-rw.

owner.description: Database owner role. Must equal the username key in the referenced Secret.

storage.description: A bare number here is bytes, which is never what anyone means.

resources.description: Requests and limits for the postgres container, rendered as the CNPG Cluster's spec.resources. Changing it restarts the database at instances: 1 (TM-0595).

enabled.description: Unset follows capabilities.dataProtection (on); true or false overrides. TM-0312.

unbackedAlert.description: Render TockmoxModelGatewayDatabaseUnbacked while backups are off.

restoreDrill.description: Weekly scheduled restore drill: bootstraps a new cluster from the object store, verifies it, records PASS/FAIL in the tockmox-restore-drill-register ConfigMap, tears down.

schedule.description: Five-field Kubernetes cron, unlike the six-field CNPG backup schedule.

serverName.description: Name this cluster archives under in the object store. Empty keeps CNPG's default, the cluster name.

recovery.description: Bootstrap the cluster from an ObjectStore backup (bootstrap.recovery) instead of an empty initdb. Default off.

hooks.description: Site-supplied LiteLLM hook files, rendered into the ConfigMap tockmox-litellm-hooks and mounted at /etc/litellm/hooks. Registration is litellm.proxy_config.litellm_settings.callbacks.

files.description: File name -> file content. A flat module or data file; a ConfigMap key cannot contain a slash.

policyGate.description: The Tockmox policy gate for the model gateway (TM-0383): a pre-call hook that assigns every request a class (open, internal, restricted) from the alias it asks for and refuses one whose class may not use that alias's endpoint tier. Off by default. Enabling it also needs hooks.tockmox_gate.tockmox_gate in litellm.proxy_config.litellm_settings.callbacks; templates/preflight.yaml checks both, and the model list's tags and endpoint tiers. docs/usage/ai-plane.md.

enabled.description: Render the gate module and its policy into the tockmox-litellm-hooks ConfigMap.

enforcement.description: enforce refuses and tags; shadow only writes audit lines, marking what it would have refused.

platformMode.description: dark_site pins every request to restricted, whatever its alias.

policyId.description: Written into every audit line, so a line names the policy that decided it.

defaultClass.description: The class of a request whose alias has no route posture. Locked to restricted (REQ-0002 J2).

classes.description: Which endpoint tiers each class may use. restricted must be exactly [local].

routePosture.description: Model alias -> class. The deterministic escalation grant: choosing an alias whose posture is open is the server-recognised choice to allow an external tier. Every alias in litellm.proxy_config.model_list must have one.

consoleKey.description: The chart-minted virtual key for Open WebUI (TM-0460 ruling B1, 2026-10-08): a Job that waits for the gateway, calls POST /key/generate with the master key and creates the Secret the console reads, doing nothing when it already exists. `enabled` unset follows the console and the gateway together; false keeps the manual step in install.md. templates/gateway-key.yaml. `check` is the detective control beside it (TM-0982): a CronJob that sends the console's key to the gateway and fails on a rejection, with the TockmoxConsoleKeyRejected rule on it; templates/console-key-check.yaml.

enabled.description: Unset follows apps.openWebui and apps.litellm together (and the console's openaiApiKeyExistingSecret naming secretName). false keeps the manual post-install step. true refuses to render unless both components do.

secretName.description: The Secret the Job writes and the console reads. Must equal open-webui.openaiApiKeyExistingSecret, or the Job mints a key nothing uses; the render refuses the mismatch.

secretKey.description: The key inside that Secret. Must equal open-webui.openaiApiKeyExistingSecretKey.

alias.description: The key's alias in LiteLLM. On an alias collision the Job retries once with a timestamp suffix.

generateExtra.description: Extra fields merged into the /key/generate request body (for example {"models": ["local-chat"]}).

image.description: The Job's image; needs kubectl, curl and jq. Redirected by global.imageRegistry.

waitSeconds.description: How long one attempt polls the gateway before the Job's backoff takes over.

check.description: The console-key check (TM-0982): a CronJob with no token and no master key that sends GET /v1/models to the gateway with the console's key. Exit 1 on 401/403 is the only failure the TockmoxConsoleKeyRejected rule counts; a gateway that does not answer is not a rejection. Renders only when the console-key Job does.

enabled.description: false turns the check and its rule off while keeping the Job.

schedule.description: Cron schedule, UTC. Every 15 minutes by default; the rule's `for` is 5 minutes, so a rejection pages within about 20 minutes of the run that saw it.

suspend.description: Keep the CronJob but stop scheduling it.

upgradeBackup.description: The pre-upgrade backup hook (TM-1054): a PreSync Job that takes a CNPG Backup of an application's database when that application's version changes, and fails the sync if the Backup does not complete.

enabled.description: null follows whether the gateway database has backups on (capabilities.dataProtection); false removes the hook.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for one Backup to reach completed.

openWebuiClusterName.description: The CNPG Cluster holding Open WebUI's database, if the site runs it on CNPG. Empty: Open WebUI is not backed up by this hook.

image.description: Image the hook runs kubectl and jq from. Empty is the restore drill's image.

ingress.description: Ingress for this layer's UIs. Hostnames derive from global.internalDomain.

className.description: Empty uses the cluster default IngressClass.

litellm.description: Upstream litellm-helm chart values (aliased), passed through unchanged.

create.description: Keys from this map that the chart CREATES. Others are referenced only.

open-webui.description: Upstream open-webui chart values, passed through unchanged.

mergeAccountsByEmail.description: Open WebUI OAUTH_MERGE_ACCOUNTS_BY_EMAIL. Default true. Authentik does not enforce unique emails: two users sharing an address merge into one Open WebUI account.

tockmox-common.description: The Tockmox library chart. It has no values interface; the block exists so a site cannot be surprised by a schema rejection if it sets one.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

observability.description: Metrics, logs, and the ServiceMonitor/PrometheusRule objects this repo writes. Decline it and set apps.serviceMonitors.enabled to keep the monitors for your own Prometheus operator.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

notifications.description: Alerts that reach a person: the sink, the bridge and the heartbeat that proves the path. Its component switch is notifications.enabled, which predates this framework.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

identity.description: Single sign-on across every console, and the identity provider behind it.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

aiPlane.description: The private AI plane: the chat console and the model gateway in front of it.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

dataProtection.description: Backups that go somewhere, and the object store, backup plugin and snapshot control plane underneath them.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

hardwareTelemetry.description: SMART and SNMP telemetry from physical hardware. Off by default, because the reference deployment is a virtual machine.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

workflowAutomation.description: Scheduled and event-driven jobs inside the cluster, with a console to watch them.

enabled.description: Unset means components follow this capability; true or false overrides.

networkPolicy.description: Default-deny between namespaces. Decline it on a CNI that does not enforce NetworkPolicy, where these objects are decoration.

capabilities.description: Named functional capabilities: one switch per functional story, spanning whatever components it takes across whichever layers they live in. CLOSED, unlike `global`: nothing upstream reads this block, so an unrecognised name here is always a typo, and an ignored typo means a capability you thought you declined is still on. See docs/administration/capabilities.md.

snapshot-controller.description: Not this layer's key. Owned by the platform layer. Accepted and ignored here because one values file is passed to every layer; see docs/administration/values-contract.md.

probes.description: Blackbox Probe objects. The exporter shipped with none, so it ran and measured nothing.

module.description: A module name from the blackbox exporter's own config.

consoles.description: Subdomain under global.internalDomain -> probe it or not.

platformNetpol.description: Not this layer's key. Owned by the policy layer. Accepted and ignored here because one values file is passed to every layer; see docs/administration/values-contract.md.

podSecurity.description: Not this layer's key. Owned by the policy layer. Accepted and ignored here because one values file is passed to every layer; see docs/administration/values-contract.md.

grafanaDatabase.description: Not this layer's key. Owned by the observability layer. Accepted and ignored here because one values file is passed to every layer; see docs/administration/values-contract.md.

inferenceNodes.description: REQ-0047 inference nodes: machines outside the cluster that serve models. Experimental in 0.8.0. The gateway's routes to them are derived from this block when render.enabled. See docs/administration/inference-nodes.md.

enabled.description: Render the gateway config (with derived node routes) as ConfigMap configMapName. Needs litellm.proxyConfigMap.create: false and name: configMapName.

engine.description: The serving engine (tockmox-ui/app/nodes.py ENGINES; tools/check-inference-nodes.sh holds the two equal). The UI refuses any other value at start.

type.description: The hardware profile the Tockmox UI knows (tockmox-ui/app/nodes.py CATALOG; tools/check-inference-nodes.sh holds the two equal). Absent means openai-compatible. The UI refuses any other value at start (lab F4, 2026-10-08: 'workstation' rendered and the UI went into CrashLoopBackOff).

management.description: Set enrolled: true for a node the admin has enrolled for GitOps convergence (tockmox-ai-node). Only an enrolled node has a convergence and a readiness on the Tockmox UI's Nodes page, and only enrolled nodes get the TockmoxAiNode* alerts. Leave it out for a node you only register (import-only, the default).

num_ctx.description: Ollama context length in tokens. Required on every route to an Ollama endpoint; the template refuses a route without it, since the schema cannot see the endpoint's engine (TM-0957).

monitoring.description: Prometheus scrape targets for each node's exporters and a blackbox probe per engine endpoint (TM-0920). Needs the observability capability's serviceMonitors.

aiNodes.description: Fleet-wide facts about enrolled nodes. The Tockmox UI reads them (it fills the bootstrap command with siteRepo and toolkitRef, judges convergence against convergeIntervalSeconds) and so does the alert template.

siteRepo.description: The site repository the nodes pull ai-nodes/ from, as the bootstrap's --site-repo takes it: an https:// URL or user@host:path.

toolkitRef.description: The Tockmox release tag the nodes pin (the bootstrap's --toolkit-ref).

convergeIntervalSeconds.description: How often a node converges; must equal ai-nodes/fleet.yaml's defaults.convergeIntervalSeconds (900 there by default). The UI calls a node Healthy within twice it, and TockmoxAiNodeConvergeStale fires after three.

adminCidrs.description: The administrator networks offered to a new node's ai-node.yaml as access.adminCidrs.

modelLifecycle.description: REQ-0048 model lifecycle: the catalog, promotion settings and the eval gateway. Experimental. See docs/administration/model-lifecycle.md.

track.description: What the watcher looks upstream for (tockmox-ui/app/models.py TRACKS). Absent or empty: nothing, and the report lists the entry as a gap. quants needs baseModel.

baseModel.description: The Hugging Face repo a quantisation is a quantisation OF (for example Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B). Needed by track quants; successors uses it in place of model when set.

frontier.description: frontier.tags was withdrawn: hosted candidates land untagged; tags are chosen at promotion.

allowedClients.description: Who may reach the eval gateway. Empty means nobody.

productionKeys.description: Default model list for virtual keys minted with none, on the production gateway (TM-0920). Needs inferenceNodes.render. Mint-time only: defense in depth, not a fence.

watch.description: The model watcher CronJob (chart keys below); every other key is read by the watcher and the PR opener.

tockmoxUi.description: The Tockmox UI (experimental in 0.8.0): opt-in Deployment with its own NetworkPolicy; site-built image (TM-0902). See docs/administration/tockmox-ui.md.

config.description: The UI's own config.yaml (site, apps, roles, oidc, features, updateCheck ...).

tockmoxRepo.description: Optional. Unset, the Tockmox layers are the Applications whose source path is charts/tockmox-<layer>, whichever repository serves them. Set it to match on one repository URL (TM-0979).

platformLedgerToken.description: Optional. A Secret (key: token) holding the bearer token for the agent ledger Platform Management reads (config.features.platform.ledgerUrl). Mounted only when config.features.platform.enabled.

platformSpecialistsToken.description: Optional. A Secret (key: token) holding the bearer token Platform Management uses as the caller client/tockmox-ui to read the Service Desk on the specialist host (config.features.platform.specialistsUrl). Mounted only when config.features.platform.enabled.

updateFeed.description: The update feed from a ConfigMap mounted at /feed (TM-1027); set config.updateCheck.feedUrl to file:///feed/releases.json. A file feed opens no HTTPS egress.

platformCatalog.description: Platform Management's catalog from a ConfigMap (key catalog.yaml) instead of the product default; used only when config.features.platform.enabled. See docs/administration/platform-management.md.

corednsHa.description: Not this layer's key. Owned by the platform layer. Accepted and ignored here because one values file is passed to every layer; see docs/administration/values-contract.md.

$comment: The ROOT is closed: a key that is neither a Tockmox block, a chart dependency, nor another layer's block is a typo, and a typo in a top-level key used to be accepted in silence. Keys owned by other layers are listed because ci/values.yaml and profiles/*.yaml are passed to all nine. See docs/administration/values-contract.md.
